description: Vendor target profile (not part of the canonical engineering model). Same platform facts as phase0/s6/model/target_codesys_softplc.json (measured in S3 on CODESYS Control Win V3 x64 3.5.22.30 / ModbusTCP Server Device 4.6.0.0). S2 adds only the CODESYS project naming pattern. REAL32 register order is NOT declared here: it is measured by verification and compared with the S3 measurement.

platform.target: CODESYS Control Win V3 x64 / ModbusTCP Server Device 4.6.0.0 (type 115, id 0000 0002)
platform.register_capacity_note: Measured in S3: the ScriptEngine-created server exposes 10 holding + 10 input register channels; assembly-size parameters do not regenerate channels via ScriptEngine. HR10 and coil 160 answer Modbus exception 2.

bit_overlay.rule: coil/discrete-input address n -> register n div 16, PLC WORD bit ((n mod 16) + 8) mod 16
bit_overlay.evidence: S3: coil 0 -> HR0=256 (bit 8), coil 8 -> HR0=1; S3 run1/run2 TestCoil 144 -> HR9 raw 256

unsupported.reason: ScriptEngine stores the parameter but does not generate the coil/discrete-input channels (measured in S3)
assembly-size parameters do not regenerate register channels via ScriptEngine; device.update() resets them (measured in S3)

unsupported.feature: PLC-originated value of a READ_WRITE holding register visible to FC3
unsupported.reason: UpdateableHolding output channels are not generated via ScriptEngine; FC3 returns the last client-written value (measured in S3)

platform.real32_layout_rule: generator copies the 2 consecutive in-memory 16-bit words of the PLC REAL to 2 consecutive registers (lower memory word -> lower register address); the resulting wire order is measured, not assumed
